decisions.reason: The accelerator program is still on the home page in 2024 and costs little to keep, but it sits outside the firm's core machinery business, so it is at moderate risk of being cut.
The bio-based bitumen binder is a flagship with its own page in both years and supports the firm's circular, CO2-negative positioning, so management will likely continue it.
The WASTX Cleanic is a featured flagship close to the core business, built in partnership with ERMAFA and promoted on the home page in both years, so it is very likely to stay.
